editorial:
Imagine the summer before your senior year of high school, where everything is supposed to be perfect, but then your best friend suddenly pulls away. That is exactly what happens to Callie and Minnie. You will feel for Minnie as she loses her spark and starts drifting away from the person she trusted most. Instead of finding a new group of friends her own age, she ends up bonding with Callie's mom in a way that feels both weird and sweet. The whole movie has a cozy, sun-drenched vibe that makes you feel like you are right there in their small town, dealing with all that awkward teenage angst.

The acting is the real star here, as the chemistry between the teen girls and the mother feels totally real and not forced. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the emotional payoff at the end makes it worth the wait. You should definitely watch this if you love stories about growing up and messy family ties.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Callie finally confronts Minnie about her secret bond with her mother. It turns out Minnie was seeking the stability she lacked at home. After a big emotional blowout, the three of them have a heart-to-heart talk in the backyard. They do not go back to how things were, but they find a new, healthier way to be in each other's lives. It ends with Callie and Minnie hugging, showing they have finally forgiven each other.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about friendship and family secrets.
